userStories.title: Setup project with React, TypeScript and Vega-Lite dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: package.json with React, TypeScript, vega-embed or react-vega
userStories.notes: Use vega-embed or react-vega for Vega-Lite rendering

userStories.title: Define TypeScript types for SSE stream events
acceptanceCriteria: Type for StreamEvent: token | done | error
Type for token event with delta string
Type for done event with usage data
Type for error event with message

userStories.title: Create utility to read and parse .jsonl file
acceptanceCriteria: Function reads .jsonl file line by line
userStories.notes: File input should use HTML5 FileReader API

userStories.title: Implement SSE emulation with configurable delay
acceptanceCriteria: Function takes array of events and delay (50-150ms)
Emits events one by one with delay
Returns Promise that resolves when done

userStories.title: Create StreamingOutput component that displays text incrementally
acceptanceCriteria: Component receives text chunks via props
Text appears gradually as chunks arrive
userStories.notes: Use React state to accumulate text from token.delta

userStories.title: Create utility to extract and parse Vega spec from streaming text
acceptanceCriteria: Extracts JSON from markdown code blocks (```json ... ```)
Handles JSON split across multiple chunks
Returns null on parse error (doesn't throw)
userStories.notes: Vega spec may be incomplete during streaming, handle gracefully

userStories.title: Create Vega spec validator
acceptanceCriteria: Returns validation result with errors array
userStories.notes: Basic validation, don't need full Vega-Lite schema validation

userStories.title: Create VegaChartPreview component using vega-embed
acceptanceCriteria: Component receives Vega spec and data as props
userStories.notes: Use vega-embed or react-vega, handle invalid specs gracefully

userStories.title: Create FileUpload component for .jsonl files
userStories.notes: Use HTML5 FileReader API, validate file extension

userStories.title: Create Play/Stop controls and status indicator
acceptanceCriteria: Status shows: idle | streaming | done | error
userStories.notes: Status should update based on streaming state

userStories.title: Create AI Explore page component combining all parts
acceptanceCriteria: Page has FileUpload, Play/Stop controls, StreamingOutput, VegaChartPreview
Vega chart updates as spec is extracted
userStories.notes: Integrate all components, handle state management

userStories.title: Add error handling throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: File read errors are caught and displayed
JSON parse errors don't crash app
userStories.notes: All try-catch blocks, error boundaries if needed
